::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 5th 1886  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 138-9
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I am very happy to accept your offer of [£25](organizations/other_160.qmd)for the Australian edition of [Chantry House](cmy_books/cmybook_186.qmd).

I wish I could disinter A Citizen’s account of the Bristol riots of 1832.[^1] It is referred to in the [Life of Bishop Gray](other_books/otherbook_995.qmd) and said to be excellent; but I could not get it from the [London Library](organizations/other_29.qmd), and I wish I could see it before the proofs of that Chapter of Chantry House are irrevocable.

Yours very truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps John Eagles,  *The Bristol riots, their causes, progress, and consequences.  By a citizen* (Bristol, Gutch and Martin 1832).
